claims.identified: Bulbapedia, Holofoil: "Pixel or Confetti Holofoil is used primarily for cards in the McDonald's Collection sets, but was also featured on the Celebrations Classic Collection. The pattern consists of small, blocky reflective shapes scattered across the image, resembling pieces of confetti." Its Celebrations page adds that the 25-card Classic Collection subset cards "feature etching and a Confetti Holofoil pattern".
claims.mcdonaldsCaveat: McDonald's Collection cards exist as both Non Holofoil and Confetti Holofoil printings (the 2021 set: "Each card has a Non Holofoil and a Confetti Holofoil print"). The catalogue holds one row per card, so every McDonald's row in this build paints the foil rather than the plain print.
claims.relief: not claimed: no source measures the emboss
